propositions: When a ticket with a BLOCK verdict and recorded blocking findings is re-reviewed, the system must extract and match the cited evidence anchors against the current plan material to detect if blocking findings' quoted text remains unchanged.

A deterministic pre-check compares the current plan description component fingerprint against the sidecar-recorded fingerprint; if identical and at least one anchor matches verbatim, a warning is printed naming the persisting findings before review execution proceeds.

The pre-check must never hard-block re-review and must not change exit codes or verdicts, because ~8% of BLOCK→PASS transitions occur without material changes (verdict flap) and would be incorrectly frozen by a hard decline.

Anchors that cannot be matched verbatim are treated as unmatchable and never trigger the warning alone; the warning fires only when at least one anchor matched old text AND all matched anchors remain untouched.
The precheck.cited_anchor_warning flag must be recorded in the review's sidecar metrics on every plan review (True or False) to measure warning hit rate and predictive value offline.
